briefs.title: Baseline Edition: A Gulf War Under Domestic Pressure, a Hybrid Campaign in Europe, and Cuba Under Strain
briefs.bluf: The defining factor this week is the collision between the US war on Iran and US domestic politics: Democrats won both chambers on November 3 and the Vice President publicly blamed the war. Washington struck Iranian targets near Hormuz on the eve of the vote and tankers keep burning near the strait, while talks run through Gulf mediators. In Europe, a wave of hoax bomb threats against flights fits the pattern of a Russian linked hybrid campaign, unattributed so far. Russia killed 42 people at a Ukrainian aid center days before US mediated talks on November 10 and 11. Cuba is under severe strain from the oil blockade and is detaining independent journalists. This is the baseline edition, so status changes are measured from here.
briefs._s: baseline edition: a gulf war under domestic pressure, a hybrid campaign in europe, and cuba under strain the defining factor this week is the collision between the us war on iran and us domestic politics: democrats won both chambers on november 3 and the vice president publicly blamed the war. washington struck iranian targets near hormuz on the eve of the vote and tankers keep burning near the strait, while talks run through gulf mediators. in europe, a wave of hoax bomb threats against flights fits the pattern of a russian linked hybrid campaign, unattributed so far. russia killed 42 people at a ukrainian aid center days before us mediated talks on november 10 and 11. cuba is under severe strain from the oil blockade and is detaining independent journalists. this is the baseline edition, so status changes are measured from here. democrats win the house and senate democrats are projected to exceed 250 house seats and hold at least 54 senate seats. alaska (peltola leads sullivan by 637 votes) and mississippi (colom leads hyde smith by about 1,100) remain too close to call. vance blames the iran war for the losses the vice president wrote that the war was the reason republicans lost. trump acknowledged gas prices hurt but said he would go to war again. house leadership reshuffle speaker johnson will not seek to lead house republicans. scalise and jordan are running for minority leader; jeffries is running for speaker when congress convenes january 3. us strikes near hormuz on the eve of the midterms limited us strikes hit around qeshm, hengam and bandar abbas. iran's supreme national security council head said the strait stays closed until us addresses its conditions: lifting the naval blockade, waiving oil sanctions and a ceasefire including lebanon. more tankers on fire east of hormuz; tanker hit off qatar iranian state media reported two more tankers on fire. separately, the british military said a tanker was struck by projectiles off qatar. iran's security chief meets putin mohsen rezaei discussed regional issues in moscow, and iran says it will supply russian gas to neighboring countries. gaza and yemen at least four palestinians were killed in gaza on november 5. in yemen's taiz, government forces say they repelled a houthi attack; the un says water production has halved and hospitals are short of fuel. aid center strike toll reaches 42 russian bunker busting bombs hit a school used as an aid hub in komyshuvakha, then the shelter where people took cover. erdogan wants direct talks with putin; italy readies aid after talks with zelenskyy, erdogan said he wants to discuss ending the war with putin. italy is finalizing a new military aid package. putin seizes japan tobacco's russian operations; drone strike hits ozon warehouse moscow took control of jti's russian business. a drone strike set an ozon warehouse ablaze in southern russia. pla activity rebounds after typhoon lull 85 sorties from october 26 to november 1, 47 into the adiz. on november 3 to 4: 22 sorties, 7 pla navy ships and 5 official ships. beijing's ai enabled influence operations ahead of taiwan's local elections taiwanese officials report ai generated content and cyberattacks aimed at polarization and lower turnout before the november 28 vote. vietnam comments on china and laos military cooperation hanoi said the cooperation should contribute to regional stability. yoani sánchez detained in havana the 14ymedio founder was held about nine hours, the third detention of an independent journalist in havana this week after cubanet's camila acosta on tuesday. the us condemned the arrests. grid at about a third of demand the une forecast 958 mw available against 2,850 mw demand on november 2, with blackouts over 20 hours a day. government reorganization takes effect november 9 law 186 cuts central state agencies from 27 to 21. reported military mobilization cibercuba reports cuba mobilizing forces amid rising tensions with the us. transition settling after contested runoff lula won 51.8% to 48.2%. flávio bolsonaro's party acknowledged the result after his annulment call; trump called it rigged. colombia ends 'total peace' congress passed president de la espriella's bill: armed group members must disarm, identify fellow members, hand over recruited minors, surrender assets and reveal links to politicians to earn reduced sentences. leaders face at least 10 years. paraguay seizes bank tied to the president central bank took over ueno bank after its capital fell below half the legal minimum; about 3 million accounts and public pension funds frozen. poland arrests four over military supplies sent to russia part of a broader pattern of sabotage and procurement networks targeting the main aid route to ukraine. hoax bomb threats hit european aviation about ten flights threatened november 3 and four prague bound planes november 5. the eu transport chief says it is too early to say whether they are linked. prc influence operations target taiwan's november 28 vote officials cite ai generated content designed to polarize and depress turnout. narrative watch: iranian leadership messaging a statement attributed to mojtaba khamenei claims iran's control of hormuz shattered the myth of american invincibility. supermarket refrigeration systems hacked across europe unidentified hackers shut down supermarket fridges in several countries the same week as the flight threats; analysts see a pattern of low cost disruption. october ransomware roundup october incidents included a ransomware attack that disrupted patient care and surgeries at university of new mexico health sciences center. israel detains journalist abed abu shehadeh police and shin bet arrested the arab48 editor and +972 contributor in jaffa; a court extended his detention. rights groups call it part of a campaign against palestinian journalists. paraguay: ueno bank arrests prosecutors ordered the arrest of eight people including the bank's president and ceo. brazil: banco master case flávio bolsonaro is under investigation in the banco master case without formal charges, per mercopress. bangladesh garment workers win wage concessions after five days of protests and clashes with police, a new wage board agreed to a revised pay scale from december. workers seek about $242 a month. greek students march for education funding students marched in athens demanding affordable housing and more state investment in education. judge blocks deportations of afghans to afghanistan or pakistan a federal judge in new york temporarily blocked the flights, which could have begun this week. advocates warn of taliban persecution of those who worked with us troops. rep. salazar: hispanic vote punished deportation policy the miami republican said the hispanic vote punished the indiscriminate deportation of latino workers. un ends western sahara mission after 35 years minurso ended when the security council failed to renew it. russia vetoed a us draft backing moroccan sovereignty; a rival russian draft also failed. south africa's anc heading for worst local result with 28% counted, the anc had about 32%. full results expected sunday. who approves trials of two new ebola vaccines the outbreak, mostly in the drc, has killed more than 5,300 since may and kills about half of those infected. early results are hoped for in early 2027. ultra processed foods and children's developing brains a new study suggests ultra processed foods may affect children's brain development in ways that encourage weight gain. google to cut search for schools that reject ai student accounts lose ai tools unless administrators enable them, and schools that refuse ai entirely lose google search for students. former ftc chair lina khan called it coercion using a search monopoly. europe bets €525 million on chip design startups  supreme court november sitting under way arguments run november 2 to 10, including st. mary catholic parish v. roy (november 3) and department of labor v. sun valley orchards (november 10). desantis on the gop result the governor described the election as close to an extinction level event for republicans in many parts of the country. claim: brazil's runoff was rigged made by president trump on october 26. status: unsupported. brazil's electoral court certified the count, and the losing candidate's own party acknowledged the result. vaccines built for the new ebola strain head to trials a potential turning point in the drc's worst recorded outbreak. the midterms were rigged through fake ballots and compromised machines democrats won by importing foreigners and registering them to vote (great replacement framing) ebola is a hoax, a western bioweapon, or a scheme for aid groups to make money a scientist predicted the world ends on friday, november 13, 2026 russian deepfake campaign against democrats (matryoshka / operation overload and storm-1516) inauthentic accounts in competitive races, hitting both parties far right networks break with trump after the losses
